system.description:
While mounted, you have Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. Once per round, out of turn, when your mount is hit, you can take the hit instead. Your mount can't be Frightened while you ride it.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
